## Goal

What changes, and why. One or two sentences.

## Files

The files or folders this task changes.

- `rust/src/...`

## Do not touch

Files this task must leave alone. List shared files here (`Cargo.toml`, `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) unless this task owns them.

## Depends on

Issues that must be merged before this task starts. Write "none" if there are none.

- 

## Done when

How to tell that the task is finished. For example: a test passes, a screen shows the new item, a document has the new section.
